notes.readings_declared: all UNVERIFIED against Lightroom Classic (D5). Sizing: constrain_size=Resize to Fit; boxes rounded half up to pixels; LongEdge/ShortEdge read max_width; Dimensions fits both orientations; Megapixels floors both edges; output equal to the source is copied. Sharpening: unsharp mask in linear light, sigma Screen 0.5 px, Glossy ppi/240, Matte ppi/160 (refused above 64 px), strength Screen 0.4/0.8/1.2, Glossy 0.5/1.0/1.5, Matte 0.6/1.2/1.8. Watermark: every field (opacity, size Proportional/Fit/Fill, anchor, insets, clockwise rotation, sRGB-or-linear graphic encoding) a Studio reading. TIFF writes the stage resolution as whole dpi rounded half up.
